name: 210721_1649_FR_Village.wav
description:
Typical French village (binaural, please use headset for 3D effects). 
I made this recording during a nice sunny morning, sitting on a bench, in a small square of Colmars les Alpes, which is a beautiful and very typical village located in the French Alps. 
Here, you can hear birds twitting, men and women chatting while doing their daily activities and business, and many other interesting sounds from the surroundings. Please feel free to take time to listen this very nice French southern village ambience, you might like it ! ;-) 
Recorded in July 2021 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity.
